rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Provides programmatic access to CTFtime.org data for cybersecurity competition tracking and analysis. Offers tools for retrieving upcoming and historical CTF events, team rankings (global and by country), detailed event information including format and weight, competition results, and event search capabilities. Features specialized prompts for analyzing CTF events, identifying beginner-friendly competitions, and generating team performance reports, making it useful for CTF participants planning their competition schedule, researchers studying the competitive cybersecurity landscape, and teams tracking their performance against peers.
